title: We would like to speak to people who have been homeless in England about what helped them off the streets
text:
Tackling homelessness is a central policy for Burnham’s government.
We would like to speak to people who have been homeless in the past. What helped you get off the streets and into accommodation for good? Was it a government initiative? Support from charity? Help from friends or family? Or perhaps it was a combination of some or all of these? We would also like to hear about your experience of homelessness and how you look back on that time.
Share your experience
